name: Tabs
summary: Switch between sibling content panels from a line-style tab bar.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-tabs> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Each slotted panel carries its label in data-tab; switching toggles a class on persistent tab nodes so the active colour and underline animate. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: value
props.desc: Zero-based index of the active tab

props.name: [data-tab]
props.desc: The tab label for that panel

whenToUse.when: several peer content panels the user moves between within one screen
switching a compact view or mode, not larger panels
the choices are many or space is tight

opinion.note: Keep labels to one or two words, sentence case. Order tabs by expected use, most common first, and don't hide critical content behind a rarely-picked tab.
opinion.dsv3: Line tabs with a 2px underline in color-primary; inactive labels text-secondary lifting to text-default on hover. Colour + underline animate on persistent nodes via the shared motion tokens — no subtree rebuild on switch.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe holds value=0 so an active + an inactive tab both exist.
